item.title: ED’s search and seizure operations are not independent ‘civil actions’: Karnataka High Court

Attachment of property is merely an instrumentality employed in aid of prosecuting the offence of money laundering. It cannot, therefore, be artificially divorced from the criminal proceedings that give it life: High Court
